start: Settings, a member with logged workouts

steps.action: Open Settings, Your data, tap 'Save as a spreadsheet'
user_sees: Title 'Save as a spreadsheet'
Buttons 'Save my history' and 'Save my measurements'
'Every workout and set in one file (Hevy's format)...'
'Saving...' on the button
The phone's share sheet with the file
must_not: Two files or two share sheets from one tap

user_sees: A success buzz; the file opens in a spreadsheet with every workout and set
must_not: Weights in the wrong unit without saying which

start: Save as a spreadsheet, a member with body weight and measurements

user_sees: 'Saving...'
The share sheet with one file, a row per day: body weight, body fat and body measurements
must_not: The sample member's made-up measurements saved
Trainer measurements from the gym missing without a word

start: Settings, a member with workouts in the last 4 weeks

steps.action: Tap 'Ask an AI about your workouts'
user_sees: Title 'Ask an AI'
'Get advice on your training from an AI app you already use, like ChatGPT or Gemini...'
'MettleUp sends nothing. You choose where the text goes. Your name, phone number and body weight are left out.'
Button 'Share to an AI app' and 'The text you will share' with the text
must_not: The member's name, phone number or body weight in the text

steps.action: Tap 'Share to an AI app' and pick ChatGPT
user_sees: The share sheet, then the AI app with the text and a question at the end
must_not: MettleUp sending the text anywhere by itself
Two share sheets from a double tap

start: A new member with no workouts and no measurements

user_sees: 'Nothing to save yet — log a workout first.'
A plain line that there is nothing to save

steps.action: Open 'Ask an AI about your workouts'
user_sees: 'No workouts in the last 4 weeks'
'Log a workout, then come back here to ask an AI about it.'
must_not: A 'Share to an AI app' button that shares an empty text

start: Save as a spreadsheet on a phone without a share app

user_sees: 'Sharing isn't available on this phone, so the file couldn't be handed over.'

start: Ask an AI page open, the member changes units

steps.action: Change units from kg to lb in Settings, come back to 'Ask an AI'
user_sees: The text read again, now in lb
must_not: The old kg text still shown

user_sees: The new workout in the text
must_not: The text from before the workout

start: Ask an AI and the spreadsheets, a member in a gym

steps.action: Read 'The text you will share' before sharing
user_sees: No name, phone number or body weight in the text
must_not: The gym name or the member's phone number in the text
Anything sent to MettleUp or the gym

steps.action: Save my history and share it
user_sees: A file that holds only the member's own workouts
must_not: Another member's workouts in the file
